general_arguments_review.inverse: For orthonormal R, R^T R=I; subtract origin before inverse rotation. A constant distance offset never adds to velocity.
general_arguments_review.spherical: Unit-circle coordinates plus horizontal projection derive the stated RA/Dec formulas. Zero direction and polar RA degeneracy retained.
general_arguments_review.moving_frame: Differentiate o+R p entrywise to obtain odot+Rdot p+R pdot; a second derivative gives oddot+Rddot p+2Rdot pdot+R pddot without commuting matrices. Independently checked nonzero local velocity, acceleration, origin acceleration and angular acceleration via exact order2 coefficient multiplication.
general_arguments_review.rotation: Common orthogonal action preserves dot products and lengths; absolute-value axial reduction deliberately discards polarity, so original vectors are retained.
general_arguments_review.additive_scope: Relative velocities telescope in the declared common-axis/common-epoch additive model; no relativistic or unknown real-world ephemeris calculation inferred.
